* Forum|Forum|1 year ago
  
  April 24, 2025

* * *

[Stephanie Cyrill](https://forum.figma.com/members/stephanie-cyrill-201583)

* [Stephanie Cyrill](https://forum.figma.com/members/stephanie-cyrill-201583)
* New Member
*

It would be great if the Layer and Properties Panels were adjustable because they get in the way of me seeing the artboard/screens that I am working on. Another thing is that when I close these panels, I can no longer see the comments that include feedback or edits that need to be made on my screens.
Because of this, in one view I can see the comments and everything, but can barely get to the screens on the artboard to do anything about it and on the other, I can see the full artboard, but not the comments. Both options are frustrating, especially since I’m just trying to make some edits.

Therefore, I suggest making the Layer and Properties Panels adjustable so that they don’t get in the way and allowing the comments to be visible even when the panels are collapsed.

# Chevron Toggle ​

An chevron toggle displays a icon `Button` with a chevron pointing in one of four directions. It's the responsibility of the parent component to manage the direction.

## Directions ​

vue

```
< ChevronToggle  direction = "up"  /> < ChevronToggle  direction = "down"  /> < ChevronToggle  direction = "left"  /> < ChevronToggle  direction = "right"  />
```
